name: agentarmy-jwt-introspect
description: JWT introspection sidecar — function-tier image. Verifies the user JWT forwarded across the FE → MC → BE chain per ARC-ADR-002. Provides a /introspect endpoint any spoke can call to convert a Bearer token into a verified claims object (or 401). Centralizes JWKS caching + leeway handling + revocation checks so every spoke isn't re-implementing JWT verify. Scaffolded as part of the contract-backlog PR; real implementation in a follow-up.

shims.note: PyJWT[crypto] for RS256 + JWKS; httpx for JWKS fetch with caching. Constant-time signature verify is provided by the underlying cryptography library.

baked.purpose: PLANNED — FastAPI app with POST /introspect (token in, claims out or 401), GET /healthz, GET /readyz. JWKS cached with TTL.
PLANNED — POST /introspect with a known-valid JWT minted from a test signer -> claims; POST with tampered JWT -> 401; POST with expired -> 401 + leeway test.

doctor.description: PLANNED — /healthz 200; verify a freshly-minted JWT returns its claims; tampered token -> 401; expired -> 401 unless within leeway.

deploy.notes: Sidecar to any spoke that needs to verify a forwarded JWT. Internal-only ingress; the spoke calls 127.0.0.1:8084 inside the same network namespace.

contract.note: Realizes the verify-once-in-each-spoke half of ARC-ADR-002 (JWT-forwarding auth contract). No new external contract — the OAuth/OIDC issuer's JWKS is the only upstream.
